transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Well, my family told me I needed to come see you. I keep telling them that I’m the reason my friend died. I just... I didn’t call her back, and I had ugly thoughts sometimes. It's my fault. And I know the Lord is punishing everybody at church because of me. I guess they didn't know what else to do with me, so they brought me here.
Have you been feeling depressed lately?

Yes, I suppose I have. I just feel... very sad all the time. It's like a heavy weight on me that just won't lift. I don't really have any joy left in me anymore... just this awful, low feeling about everything.
Have you ever believed that you were responsible for your friend’s death or that God was punishing others when you were not feeling depressed?

No. Before my friend died and I sank into this, I never thought like that. I never believed the choir or the pastor were sending warnings about me back then. I mean... those thoughts really only started after I became so low and guilty these past few weeks.
Before this current depressive period, had you ever experienced another period of depression like this?
No... no, I haven't. I mean, I've had sad days before, just living this long, but... nothing like this. I've never had a time where it got this dark or heavy before.
